演ずる: to act (a part); to play (a role)
突き合わせる: to place persons opposite; to come face to face with
欺く: to deceive; to delude; to trick; to fool
ばら蒔く: to distribute widely (e.g. leaflets); to hand out freely; to spend recklessly
重々: fully (e.g. understand); very much; very well; exceedingly
通行: passage (of people or vehicles); passing (through); traffic
退ける: to put something out of the way; to move (something, someone) aside
堪能: enjoying to the full; full satisfaction; being satiated (with); having one's fill (of)
甘える: to take advantage of; to presume upon (e.g. another's benevolence); to depend on
逸らす: to turn away (one's eyes, face, etc.); to avert; to divert (e.g. one's attention); to evade (e.g. a question)
夢中: absorbed in; immersed in; crazy about; obsessed with
放つ: to set free; to release; to let loose
振れる: to swing; to shake; to wave
捌き: handling (e.g. knife, reins); control; use; -work (e.g. footwork)
合格: passing (an exam); pass; success; passing grade
封ずる: to prevent; to forbid; to block
拵える: to make; to manufacture; to fabricate
腕利き: highly skilled; skillful; very capable; competent

__flags__.突き合わせる: sentence has 付き合わせ (付き合わせる 'make accompany/involve'), not 突き合わせる
__flags__.わっ: わっかんない = 分かんない (わからない) with emphatic small っ, not the interjection
__flags__.放つ: 放っておく = leave alone (放っておく idiom); sense 'set free' closest
__flags__.直し: 呑み直し = 呑む + 直し (do over again, suffix), not 'correction'
__flags__.根: 根っから = through and through (adverb/idiom)
